issue.body:
This code adds a simple endpoint to apply patches to repositories and
branches on gitea. This is then used along with the conflicting checking
code in #18004 to provide a basic implementation of cherry-pick revert.

Now because the buttons necessary for cherry-pick and revert have 
required us to create a dropdown next to the Browse Source button
I've also implemented Create Branch and Create Tag operations.

Fix #3880 
Fix #17986 

Signed-off-by: Andrew Thornton <art27@cantab.net>

## Screenshots

### Apply Patch
![Screenshot from 2021-12-16 02-29-03](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1824502/146297011-8c01ea20-276e-421b-98a9-e39fe76ac046.png)
![Screenshot from 2021-12-16 02-35-26](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1824502/146297575-435bbdce-d464-4836-8fa7-a0ae56a088bf.png)
![Screenshot from 2021-12-16 02-35-34](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1824502/146297580-d8244594-3b93-4672-8e08-acddcedc92dd.png)

### Cherry Pick/Revert
![Screenshot from 2021-12-17 21-16-14](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1824502/146608999-b7b75840-caef-4d89-b05a-35035aabf0a2.png)
![Screenshot from 2021-12-17 21-17-10](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1824502/146609117-306f52bb-4eb7-4e05-8897-c5abc9698db9.png)
![Screenshot from 2021-12-16 02-39-09](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1824502/146298030-fea0dab8-af88-4b4a-8e9a-c5b9a9a2c379.png)
![Screenshot from 2021-12-16 02-39-31](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1824502/146298050-72199ae9-9989-47f2-b73c-9d184f21d519.png)

The commit message will be prefilled with the commit message being cherry-picked. 

If the cherry-pick/revert fails then the results will pass back to the apply-patch screen to adjust the patch.
